Cc: procurement@greenstack.io
Date: 2027-03-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for baseline pricing + NDA

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. GreenStack is interested in a hosted API pilot (1-2M tokens/month) and we need your standard commercial sheet to share internally. Procurement also asked for a mutual NDA before we exchange the commercial details with our legal team.

Can you:
- Share the current hosted API baseline pricing (per-token and embedding unit) and any starter package options
- Attach your mutual NDA (PDF) and indicate the version
- Let me know if you require a signature via DocuSign or a scanned signed copy will do

Would like to move quickly — target to have signed NDA by next week and commercial terms by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships, GreenStack
agm@greenstack.io

Date: 2027-03-14T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request for baseline pricing + NDA

Alicia — thanks for the quick follow. Attaching the documents you asked for: our mutual NDA (Mutual_NDA_Redwood_v1.1.pdf) and the commercial sheet (Redwood_Commercial_Sheet_v1.0.pdf).

Quick notes:
- The commercial sheet is the hosted API baseline for self-serve + committed tiers. For a 1-2M token pilot, the typical starting point is the committed tier (we can model burst and overage).
- Discounting is handled on committed volumes; standard one-off pilot discounts are approved by our CRO if requested.
- We prefer DocuSign for signatures to keep versioning clean; link below is a placeholder until legal creates the envelope. If you must return a scanned copy, we can accept it but will route through legal for countersignature.

Attachments:
- Mutual_NDA_Redwood_v1.1.pdf (PDF) — version notes: minor updates to data handling clause.
- Redwood_Commercial_Sheet_v1.0.pdf (PDF) — baseline rates and packaging.

Next steps:
1) If NDA looks good, sign via DocuSign (we'll send an envelope) or confirm scanned return
2) Once NDA is signed, we can share a redlined commercial with a pilot discount proposal (if needed)

If helpful, I can run a short internal pricing model with Aditya (cc'd) to propose a pilot discount and show unit economics.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-03-15T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request for baseline pricing + NDA — pilot discount ask

Monica / Lauren —

I took a quick look at the Commercial_Sheet_v1.0 and ran a simple model for a 1.5M token pilot (expected mix: 80% generation tokens, 20% embeddings). If GreenStack commits to a 3-month pilot we can offer a time-limited pilot discount off the committed tier. Two options I recommend we propose:

Option A (Conservative): 10% off committed unit rates for pilot months (no change to egress or features)
Option B (Introductory): 20% off committed unit rates + waived onboarding credit (one-time) in return for an executive case study after pilot

From legal: the NDA v1.1 looks fine generally but they flagged section 7 (audit rights) — Elliot, want to confirm if we should accept GreenStack's redline or request we preserve the current language?

If Lauren signs off commercially I can prepare v1.1 of the commercial sheet reflecting Option A and a separate file for Option B redline.

-Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

- Pilot Option A: 10% off committed unit rates for 3 months
- Pilot Option B: 20% off + waived one-time onboarding credit (requires exec case study)
3) Version control: filenames include _v1.0/_v1.1. If GreenStack returns a redline of the commercial sheet, please append your initials and date (e.g., GS_Initials_20270316) so we can track iterations.
